item.description:
**Murmur 1.9**
- Voice commands: say "nueva línea" or "new line", "presiona enter", "borra eso", or punctuation like "coma" while you dictate, in Spanish and English. You choose the trigger words, and spoken punctuation can be turned off. - Your own commands: say a phrase of your choice at the end of a dictation to press a shortcut, open an app or website, or rewrite what you said. - Fixed a freeze that could happen when a microphone stopped responding.

**Murmur 1.8**
- Automatic updates: Murmur checks for new versions once a day and installs them with your OK. - Transforms: select text anywhere and press ⌃⌥T to make it professional, friendlier, shorter, a list, a summary, or fix its grammar. - Scratchpad: notes for thinking out loud, with one-click clean up and transforms. - A fresh look across setup, Home and Settings.
